open_items: Muhurat trading on 2026-11-08: timings were 'to be notified' in NSE/CMTR/71775 and no timing circular was found on 2026-10-14. The session fails closed until a verified entry is added.
2027: no circular yet (normally published in December). Dates in 2027 report UNVERIFIED_YEAR; live paper fills then depend on the provider session flag alone.

sources.title: Revision in Transaction Charges (effective 2026-03-01): cash market Rs 306.99 transaction charge + Rs 0.01 IPFT per crore each side

secondary_sources: STT on delivery equity 0.1% on buy and sell; Union Budget 2026 raised STT on futures/options only, effective 2026-04-01 (multiple secondary reports; Finance Act text not independently retrieved).
SEBI turnover fee Rs 10 per crore and delivery stamp duty 0.015% on purchases (broker charge sheets; regulator texts not independently retrieved).
assumptions: Brokerage and DP charges are broker-specific; the schedule models zero brokerage and no DP charge and labels both as BROKER_ASSUMPTION.
STT is rounded to the nearest rupee per fill; contract-note rounding per scrip per day is not modelled.
The exchange charge uses the member outflow (Rs 307 per crore); brokers may pass a different amount to clients.
